targets.text: The resulting maps in both areas show distinct magnetic high response areas that coincide closely with pyrrhotite mineralization broadly developed within the footwall Onaping andesite tuff.

Other high intensity magnetic features occur within the Vermilion survey area and provide potential targets for future drilling. At Balfour (Figure 9.6), magnetic highs also correlate to pyrrhotite mineralization developed in the Onaping tuff.

Regional geological interpretations, historical drilling and geophysical anomalies have identified several untested targets, particularly within the newly acquired Mid Zone, where historical drilling intersected near-surface polymetallic mineralization.
